BiblicalUsage: Zipporah is the wife of Moses, the daughter of Jethro the priest of Midian. In Exodus 2:21, he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter. The fuller story is told on the Zipporah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zipporah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
RelatedEvents: Moses' Birth and Flight to Midian
